lastGame.title: Bills 23, Vikings 6
stats: Josh Allen: 21-of-31, 234 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT; 25-yard TD pass to Keleki Latu (Latu's first career TD)
James Cook: 31 carries, 107 yards, 1 rushing TD (5 yards)
Tyler Bass: 3 field goals (39, 25 and 52 yards)
Defense: 3 turnovers, 2 INTs (Dorian Williams, Terrel Bernard); Vikings 0-for-7 on third down
Carson Wentz: 8-of-25, 81 yards, 2 INTs for Minnesota

news.b: The Bills activated DB Jordan Hancock from injured reserve (hamstring) and released DB Te'Cory Couch to make room. QB Shane Buechele was elevated from the practice squad for the Jets game, his first elevation of the season.
Right tackle Spencer Brown (ankle) is doubtful, and Tylan Grable would likely start in his place. Christian Benford, Sam Franklin Jr. and Tyrell Shavers are questionable.
New York activated S VJ Payne from injured reserve and waived OL Kohl Levao on Saturday. Garrett Wilson (concussion) practiced fully Friday, is listed questionable and is expected to play.

news.h: Preview: run game vs. fumble-forcing Jets
news.b: Buffalo ran a season-high 44 times at Minnesota, and the Jets have allowed about 140 rushing yards per game over their last four. New York leads the NFL with 13 forced fumbles; kickoff is 1 p.m. ET on CBS from MetLife Stadium.

source: buffalobills.com roster moves (Nov 14), injury report (Nov 13), storylines (Nov 11) and schedule; newyorkjets.com Payne move (Nov 14) and Friday injury report (Nov 13); Fox Sports standings and NFL.com Week 10 schedule (Nov 15).
